supplementaryReferences.note: September–January describes fruit production; exact ripe-picking dates are not stated. Do not count leaves used as livestock fodder as household food.

care: SANBI records this frost- and drought-resistant shade tree in Karoo and Kalahari conditions.
Large amounts of its leaves can taint dairy milk, according to SANBI; this is not a ration recommendation.
purchase: Ask about male and female plants if fruit is intended. Natural distribution in the source excludes KwaZulu-Natal; broad hardiness is not a local fruit guarantee.
